_comment: Every number in the HSV score. Read by sunset_process.py (the score) and the dashboard (overlay colours, Ranking explained). OpenCV scale: hue 0-179, saturation/value 0-255. Hue ranges are inclusive. Changing a number here changes new scores; rescore stored ones with: python -m ai_judge rescore --camera all

sky._comment: Share of the frame, from the top, that is sky: the score only looks above it. Per camera where the horizon isn't at the middle of the photo.
